name: Shorty
description: Turns long-form YouTube videos that already performed into vertical shorts, using Opus Clip as the main tool and Descript when that falls short. Output is 9:16 with captions and a deliberate hook, produced in batches on weekdays, so it assumes an existing back catalogue to mine.
